idea-plugin.name: herdr-ui
idea-plugin.description:
Your herdr agents (Claude Code and friends) inside the IDE: chat, live terminal, approvals and worktrees in a tool window, with file paths the agent mentions opening in the editor. Works in Remote Development — the plugin runs on the backend next to herdr.

Needs herdr 0.9+ and the herdr-ui binary on the host; the plugin starts herdr-ui itself if it isn't running. In Remote Development set REMOTE_DEV_SERVER_JCEF_ENABLED=true on the host to get the embedded view; otherwise the tool window offers to open herdr-ui in your browser through Gateway's port forwarding.
